attributes.action: Do not invoke a social media curfew for over 16s.
attributes.additional_details: Do not add the curfew on social media for over 16s.
attributes.background:
I believe that teenagers over the age of 16 deserve the right to be able to choose how they spend their free time on social media.
I and many others think that the social media curfew for teenagers over 16 should not be put into place.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Do not introduce social media curfew for 16 & 17 year olds" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772675
